'''Teraeza Furloti''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] from [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], who served as an operative for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], she was stationed undercover in the city of [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]] where she was the first Alliance operative to discover information on the existence of a [[Geonosian Bio-Lab|Geonosian biogenics lab]] that was still operational. The lab was found to be creating mutated [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Kwi]]s and [[Kliknik]]s, which were then provided to the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] as minions.<ref name="AED" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Teraeza Furloti appeared as a non-player character in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online-[[roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.
